Q937.reason: Morphine is an opioid depressant that relieves pain and causes sedation. It is not a stimulant, and it causes constipation, not diarrhoea.

Q922.reason: Fatigue in high-intensity exercise occurs when ATP supply fails to keep up with demand. ADP does not fall, because it rises as ATP is used.

Q992.reason: Rape is a general intent crime, so voluntary intoxication is no defence. An honest but unreasonable belief in consent does not excuse it at common law.
